scope: local exact-scope immutable source text; no provider payload or grant
rules: existing syntax-only detector, no legal-ID/checksum validity claim
unsupportedResolution: one internal rule must fully contain each native unmapped text span; all segments complete first; no adjacent union
knownCategoryOverlap: cross-category overlap blocks; same-category learned within rule dedups retaining whole rule
blockedOutput: result detections empty; rule diagnostics retained separately; protectionPlan null
scoreUse: diagnostic only; rule-retention is not a quality improvement; no eligibility claim
parentValidation: Independently recompute operational gates, syntax rules and deterministic composition from original input and declared native spans; require exact complete output, internally valid blocked diagnostics, and absolute IPC request deadlines.
requestLifetime: One absolute timeout includes readiness and IPC; cancellation before/during readiness terminates worker, removes request listener/timer and forbids dispatch after settlement.
